function.arguments:
{"shell_command": "ls -l sales.csv && head -5 sales.csv && python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
with open('sales.csv', newline='') as f:
    r=csv.DictReader(f)
    print('columns:', r.fieldnames)
    total=0
    n=0
    for row in r:
        v=row.get('units')
        if v is None:
            raise SystemExit('No units column')
        if v.strip():
            total += float(v) if '.' in v else int(v)
        n+=1
    print('rows:', n)
    print('total:', total)
PY"}
